title: Introduce presubmit telemetry adapter and slim toolchain images to speed CI feedback
author: Kara Nguyen
description: Motivation: our presubmit lanes were noisy and slow because of full toolchain spins and insufficient telemetry for flaky tests. This PR introduces a lightweight presubmit telemetry adapter that collects per-test stability signals, and a set of slim toolchain images to reduce job startup time. The goal is to shrink median presubmit walltime by ~30% and give SRE/engineers actionable signals about test flakiness so we can triage/flake-gate faster. What changed: 1) tools/presubmit/telemetry-adapter: new Go service that consumes test result events (Junit/JSON) and emits a compact per-test stability profile to S3/observable store (backwards-compatible format). 2) ci/toolchain/slim-Dockerfiles: reduced build images for presubmit and lint lanes (node/protoc/golang trimmed to minimal sets). 3) .github/workflows/presubmit.yml: introduce staged lanes (fast-lint, unit-slim, integration) and integrate telemetry adapter as a post-step; add conditional caching warm-up. 4) scripts/ci/prepare_presubmit.sh: new fastpath that loads the slim image if available and falls back gracefully. 5) docs/ci/presubmit.md: migration notes and rollout plan. Backwards compatibility: existing presubmit consumers will continue to upload JUnit artifacts; adapter reads both legacy and new formats. Rollout plan: enable telemetry adapter in opt-in mode for 2 weeks, then flip global opt-in after observing signal quality. Checklist: - [x] implement telemetry adapter (unit tested) - [x] publish slim images to internal registry - [x] staged presubmit workflow and gating - [x] docs and migration notes - [x] smoketest on dev branch on multiple node versions Performance: on staging we see median presubmit reduce from ~18m to ~12m on typical changes that only affect TS/Go files. Security: slim images have fewer packages which reduces surface area; adapter written in Go with explicit TLS for artifact uploads. Related: ENG-2139 (presubmit stability), ENG-2140 (toolchain cost reduction).

release_notes: Add presubmit telemetry adapter (opt-in) and slim presubmit toolchain images to reduce presubmit latency and provide per-test stability signals. Migration steps documented in docs/ci/presubmit.md.
notes_for_ops: Adapter writes compact stability profiles to s3://redwood-presubmit-telemetry/. Ensure lifecycle policy is 90d and grant putObject to CI service account. Image publish uses ci/ci-images/publish.yml, registry: internal-registry.redwood.local/presubmit-slim.
rollback_plan: If adapter causes unexpected load or false positives, set PRESUBMIT_TELEMETRY=off in .github/workflows/presubmit.yml and remove post-step. To revert slim images, temporarily pin presubmit workflow to use ci/toolchain/Dockerfile.full.* images.
estimated_impact: Presubmit median walltime reduced ~30% in staging; first-week opt-in will not change merge gating. Expected cost savings: ~18% CI compute for presubmit lanes after global rollout.
